payload.claim: The spec declares `risk: standard` while its `touches` list includes `saffron/ledger.py`, which is one of `.saffron/policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on` paths; most past done specs that touch `saffron/ledger.py` declare `risk: elevated` instead. This makes no functional difference, since `saffron/repos/policy.py::effective_risk` recomputes the effective tier from the changed-file list regardless of the spec's declared value, so the `size` gate will still block here once the diff touches `ledger.py`, and there is direct precedent for `risk: standard` on specs touching `ledger.py` (`SA-0264`, `SA-0275`).
